title: An L 3 bound for the trilinear Hilbert transform
summary: We prove that the trilinear Hilbert transform with fixed slopes 1, 2, 3 maps $`L^3(\mathbb R)\times L^3(\mathbb R)\times L^3(\mathbb R)`$ to $`L^1(\mathbb R)`$, resolving this case of the trilinear Hilbert transform conjecture.
family_title: An L 3 bound for the trilinear Hilbert transform

review.reason: Proves an L3 mapping bound for the trilinear Hilbert transform with fixed slopes.
